text:
[LFCA.4.2] Hydration's author-visible modifiers (`retain`, `limit`,
an adapter's `filter`, the `corr` slot on hydration
targets) are part of how hydration works and are not
independently gateable. Disable the category as a unit
when the tier has no facts- or samples-plane connection or
when the working-memory budget can't absorb bulk loads.
